Write `tTest_2sample(a, b)` — two-sample t-test. Test.

```falcon
func tTest_2sample(a, b) =
  {
    local na = a.listLen()
    local nb = b.listLen()
    local ma = a
      .reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / na
    local mb = b
      .reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / nb
    local va = a
      .map { x -> (x - ma) ^ 2 }
      .reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / (na - 1)
    local vb = b
      .map { x -> (x - mb) ^ 2 }
      .reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / (nb - 1)
    local se = sqrt(va / na + vb / nb)
    local t_stat = (ma - mb) / se
    local df = na + nb - 2
    { "t" : t_stat, "df" : df, "mean_a" : ma, "mean_b" : mb }
  }

println(tTest_2sample([2.1, 2.5, 2.3, 2.8, 2.6], [1.8, 2.0, 1.9, 2.1, 1.7]))
```
Write `bayesianInference(prior, likelihood, data)` — Bayes update. Return posterior parameters. Test.

```falcon
func bayesianInference(prior, likelihood, data) =
  {
    local mu0 = prior.get("mean", [])
    local sig0 = prior.get("std", [])
    local sig_l = likelihood.get("std", [])
    local n = data.listLen()
    local data_mean = data
      .reduce(0) { x, s -> x + s } / n
    local post_var = 1 / ((1 / sig0) ^ 2 + (n / sig_l) ^ 2)
    local post_mean = post_var * ((mu0 / sig0) ^ 2 + (n * data_mean / sig_l) ^ 2)
    { "mean" : post_mean, "std" : sqrt(post_var) }
  }

println(bayesianInference({ "mean" : 0, "std" : 1 }, { "std" : 0.5 }, [0.3, 0.5, 0.4, 0.6]))
```

```falcon

triangles = triangles
  .sort { a, b -> 
    local za = (a.get("verts", [])[1][3] + a.get("verts", [])[2][3] + a.get("verts", [])[3][3]) / 3
    local zb = (b.get("verts", [])[1][3] + b.get("verts", [])[2][3] + b.get("verts", [])[3][3]) / 3
    za < zb
  }

```
